field_evidence: Official MHCLG Planning Data listed-building-outline entity 42149181 contains an authoritative closed and nonzero-area MultiPolygon for Kensington Fire Station, Kensington and Chelsea, reference 425735, entry-date 27 March 1991. Historic England statutory NHLE record 1265214 at 13 Old Court Place, Grade II, first listed 27 March 1991, identifies official legacy system number 425735 and describes a purpose-built fire station and flats constructed 1903-1904 by H F T Cooper, with appliance room and fire station facilities. The official legacy number links these separate identifiers without inventing a direct outline listed-building foreign key. BUILDING_PRESENT and historical type Fire station are substantiated.
